# $TOKE / McToken — mctoken.xyz

> The official front door for $TOKE (McToken), a community + utility token on Solana. This site is the
> project hub: live market stats, the Great McVote governance history, and the gateway to the ecosystem's
> machine-readable surfaces. For holder-level on-chain data and the versioned data API, use the TOKE
> Explorer and the TOKE API linked below.

- Token: **$TOKE** (McToken) · chain: **solana-mainnet**
- Mint: `AmgUMQeqW8H74trc8UkKjzZWtxBdpS496wh4GLy2mCpo` · decimals: 3 · max supply: 420,000,069
- Canonical site: https://mctoken.xyz
- This page is a client-rendered SPA. Live numbers and structured data are served by the TOKE API below —
  agents should prefer those JSON endpoints over scraping the rendered page.

## Machine-readable data (TOKE API v1)
- [Oracle](https://api.mctoken.xyz/v1/oracle): live liquidity-weighted price, implied market cap, total liquidity, 24h change. JSON, CORS-open, no auth.
- [Token facts](https://api.mctoken.xyz/v1/token.json): canonical supply, holders count, mint/freeze authorities, pools.
- [Dataset catalog](https://api.mctoken.xyz/v1/index.json): every dataset the API serves.
- `https://api.mctoken.xyz/v1/<dataset>` proxies the explorer's published `/api/v1/<dataset>` — one canonical API for the whole ecosystem.

## The ecosystem
- [TOKE Explorer](https://explorer.mctoken.xyz): every wallet that ever touched $TOKE — anonymous, on-chain-verifiable, reconciled every ~6h. Its own agent guide: https://explorer.mctoken.xyz/llms.txt
- [Toke Story](https://story.mctoken.xyz): the origin story and lore of $TOKE.

## Notes
- Informational only — not financial advice. $TOKE is a community token; always verify on-chain.
- Public, read-only data. No API key, no published rate limit — please cache.
